snippet.title: Tiny Dangerous Dungeons Remake - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Get in on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179810/Tiny_Dangerous_Dungeons_Remake/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiny-dangerous-dungeons-remake/id6740786293
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adventureislands.tinyddremake

Classic mini metroidvania Tiny Dangerous Dungeons returns in a completely rebuilt adventure! Guide Timmy the little treasure hunter through a new,  twice as large dungeon than in the original game! Discover new puzzles, new items, new secrets, and battle ferocious new bosses!
